defaults._comment_fallbackChain: Chromium-family FIRST (chrome -> edge), firefox LAST. playwright-firefox cannot reliably click on this storefront or the AngularJS Admin SPA: browser_click hangs on Playwright's 'visible, enabled and stable' actionability gate and times out on fully-visible, non-moving elements (verified NOT a layout/CLS bug). Confirmed independently 5x: 2026-06-01 (SBTM-orders), 2026-06-24 (REG-2026-06-24-2108, whole Admin SPA), 2026-07-25, 2026-07-27 x2, and again 2026-08-05 (REG-2026-08-05-1942 attempt 1, suite 002). Firefox was previously SECOND here, so any suite whose first attempt failed fell straight onto the one lane that cannot click - burning a full retry before reaching edge. Root cause is in the @playwright/mcp layer, not Firefox/Playwright itself: raw playwright-core + firefox clicks the same reproducer fine headed AND headless, with and without the MCP's recordHar/viewport/locale context options (probed 2026-08-05). Firefox stays in the pool for read-only/navigation-light passes; see .claude/rules/agents.md and the feedback_firefox_cart_dropdown_quirk memory.

browserPool.constraint: READ-ONLY / NAVIGATION-LIGHT PASSES ONLY — do NOT schedule click-driven suites here (cart, checkout, merge, PDP interaction, sign-in, any Admin SPA suite). browser_click times out on the actionability 'stable' gate; browser_type and navigation work fine. If both Chromium slots are busy, QUEUE the suite for the next free chrome/edge slot rather than placing it on firefox — a firefox placement costs a full wasted attempt, not a degraded one.

Thresholds derive from scripts/lib/measure-layout.ts (npm run tokens:sync).

suites.notes: VCST-5544. Needs App Insights READ access (AAD via Connect-AzAccount, or APPINSIGHTS_API_KEY_BACKEND) — without it every telemetry assertion is unverifiable, not failing. Adaptive sampling on the AI resource (~1-in-8) means a single request may leave no telemetry: repeat >=14x or disable sampling before concluding a signal is absent. 4 cases are Manual (InputCaptureMode matrix + bridge-off + breaking-change communication) and need an ISOLATED stand: the settings bind through a cached IOptions and are read only at startup, so each change is an appsettings edit + platform restart. Excluded from the backend/full selections until /qa-test 5g promotion — 19 cases are still Draft and UCPO-005/014/018 intentionally document defects that are OPEN.

suites.name: Background Jobs — Hangfire Migration
suites.notes: VCST-5490. _COVERAGE-GAP (2026-08-17): RefundChangedJobHandler and CancelPaymentJobHandler have REGISTRATION + SECURITY-GATE coverage only (BGJ-006 flags both triggerable=false; BGJ-009 enqueue-refused for CancelPaymentJobHandler; BGJ-010 enqueue-refused for RefundChangedJobHandler) — their BUSINESS OUTCOME is NOT covered on any environment. Two cases (former BGJ-030 CancelPaymentJobHandler trigger path, former BGJ-031 RefundChangedJobHandler via Return resolution) were authored, evidence-checked live, and REMOVED rather than left permanently BLOCKED. Why: (1) no void/cancel REST route exists at all — only capture/refund; (2) neither payment gateway on this env supports refund — DefaultManualPaymentMethod returns 200 {succeeded:false, errorCode:"PAYMENT_FAILED"} (a leaked EF DbUpdateException), SkyflowPaymentMethod returns 200 {succeeded:false, errorCode:"INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR", errorMessage:"Payment method does not support refund"}; (3) seeded fixtures carry 0 payment transactions (paymentStatus=Paid was set directly by the seeder, nothing to refund against); (4) the only other candidate trigger — VirtoCommerce.Return's resolution field — does NOT create a payment refund: `resolution` is a free-text nullable string (not an enum), all 4 pre-existing returns with resolution="refund" have orders with refunds=0 (two still payment-status New), and neither Return creation nor Return approval (New->Approved) raises an order event (confirmed live: modifiedDate/changelog/all Hangfire queues unchanged). There is no reachable path to either handler's business outcome on any environment available to this suite. What a future environment would need to re-add these cases: a refund-capable payment gateway (neither DefaultManualPaymentMethod nor Skyflow qualifies) PLUS an order whose payment carries a real captured transaction (not a directly-seeded PaymentStatus=Paid with no transaction history) — that precondition should gate re-authoring, not just re-running. IDs BGJ-030/BGJ-031 are retired, not reused.
